text:
Dear Mr. Nakamura,

Thank you for reviewing my mortgage application. I am buying a two-bedroom condo in Kailua-Kona because it is ten minutes from my job and close to my parents, who are getting older.

I have worked as a dental hygienist at the same office for four years, and my income is steady. I made a detailed budget, and the monthly payment, HOA fee and insurance together are about thirty percent of my take-home pay. I saved for the down payment for three years, and I will still have an emergency fund of four months of expenses after closing.

I will set up autopay so every payment is on time. I have never missed a bill, and I take this commitment seriously.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,
Alana Medeiros

Dear Loan Officer,

I am applying for a loan to buy a three-bedroom house in Hilo. My wife and I are expecting our second child, and this home is in a safe neighborhood near a good school.

I have been employed as a firefighter with the county for six years, and my salary is stable. We built a household budget, and the mortgage payment fits with room left for bills, food and saving. We have saved our down payment and we keep a separate emergency fund that covers several months of expenses.

We are responsible borrowers and we have always paid our car loan on time. I commit to making every payment on time.

I appreciate your consideration.

Respectfully,
Daniel Kahananui

Dear Ms. Tanaka,

My name is Kai Akana and I want to buy a small house in Waimea. I want it because it is close to my work and my family lives nearby.

I have worked as a ranch hand for three years and my income is steady. I made a budget and I know I can afford the payment each month. I saved money every month for the down payment, and I have an emergency fund too.

I promise to make every payment on time, and I will use autopay so I never forget. I am a reliable person.

Thank you for your time and for reading my letter.

Sincerely,
Kai Akana

To the lending team,

I am writing to share a little about myself and the condo I hope to buy in Honolulu. After renting for five years, I want a home I can take care of and build equity in. The building is close to the bus line, which keeps my commute simple.

I work as an accountant, and I have been with the same firm since I graduated. My income has grown every year. I tracked my spending for a full year before applying, so I know the payment fits my budget. I have saved the down payment and I will keep reserves for repairs and emergencies.

I have a history of paying every bill on time and I am fully committed to this loan.

Thank you for your consideration.

Kind regards,
Grace Liu
